'''Andrew Robert Muirhead''' (born 1975) is an Australian former radio and television presenter for the [[Australian Broadcasting Corporation]]. He was the presenter of [[ABC Radio Hobart]]'s breakfast program in Tasmania and also the presenter of the [[Collectors (TV series)|''Collectors'']] television program from 2005 to 2010.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theage.com.au/entertainment/the-trouble-with-aunty-20050320-gdztm0.html|title=The trouble with Aunty|last=Courtis|first=Brian|date=20 March 2005|work=The Age|access-date=16 June 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theage.com.au/national/collectors-may-be-dumped-as-host-faces-porn-charge-20100612-y4ri.html |title=Collectors may be dumped as host faces porn charge |publisher=The Age |date=13 June 2010 |access-date=2010-07-01 | location=Melbourne | first=Andrew | last=Darby| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100711234349/http://www.theage.com.au/national/collectors-may-be-dumped-as-host-faces-porn-charge-20100612-y4ri.html| archive-date= 11 July 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref> In 2012, he pleaded guilty to accessing child pornography and served four months of a five-month jail sentence.<ref name="The Age">{{cite news|url=https://www.theage.com.au/entertainment/tv-and-radio/exabc-host-andy-muirhead-leaves-prison-early-20130228-2f7go.html |title=Ex-ABC host Andy Muirhead leaves prison early |publisher=The Age |date=28 February 2013 |access-date=2013-02-28 | location=Melbourne}}</ref>

==Career==
Muirhead had worked in TV and radio since 2004<ref name=ebroadcast/> and had also performed comedy prior to the convictions.<ref name=day>{{cite news|url=http://www.smh.com.au/news/entertainment/stay-in-touch/stay-in-touch-feature/three-questions-andy-muirhead/2008/10/20/1224351152281.html|title=Three questions: Andy Muirhead|last=Day|first=Samantha|date=20 October 2008|work=The Sydney Morning Herald|access-date=16 June 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theage.com.au/entertainment/art-and-design/andy-muirhead-is-perky-20060418-ge25h6.html|title=Andy Muirhead is&nbsp;... Perky?|last=Hunter|first=Tim|date=18 April 2006|work=The Age|access-date=16 June 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theage.com.au/entertainment/art-and-design/andy-muirhead-20070427-ge4rdt.html|title=Andy Muirhead|last=Paul|first=Margaret|date=27 April 2007|work=The Age|access-date=16 June 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.australianstage.com.au/reviews/micf/only-human--andy-muirhead-1269.html|title=Only Human &#124; Andy Muirhead|last=Mattarelli|first=Vito|date=23 March 2008|work=Australian Stage|access-date=16 June 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100615232138/http://www.australianstage.com.au/reviews/micf/only-human--andy-muirhead-1269.html| archive-date= 15 June 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref> He represented Tasmania in the 2003 [[Raw Comedy]] National finals<ref name=ebroadcast/> and had appeared at the [[Melbourne International Comedy Festival]] from 2004 prior to the convictions.<ref name=radio/>

==Personal life==
Muirhead was born in [[Sale, Victoria]] and moved to [[Hobart]], [[Tasmania]] with his family. He graduated from the [[University of Tasmania]] in 1998. He worked as a biologist for a forestry company doing insect and mammal surveys while also doing stand-up comedy. He lived in Hobart with his long-term partner prior to the convictions.<ref name=ebroadcast>{{cite news|url=http://www.ebroadcast.com.au/enews/television/Q-A-Andy-Muirhead-030310.html|title=Q&A: Andy Muirhead|date=3 March 2010|work=eBroadcast|access-date=16 June 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100614203958/http://www.ebroadcast.com.au/enews/television/Q-A-Andy-Muirhead-030310.html|archive-date=14 June 2010|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name=radio>{{cite news|url=http://www.smh.com.au/news/money/radios-revival/2008/06/09/1212863542107.html|title=Radio's revival|last=Cockington|first=James|date=11 June 2008|work=The Sydney Morning Herald|access-date=16 June 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.couriermail.com.au/entertainment/tv/collecting-collectors/story-e6freqj6-1111113828765|title=Collecting collectors|last=Nicholson|first=Sarah|date=27 June 2007|work=The Courier-Mail|access-date=16 June 2010}}</ref>

===Child pornography conviction===
{{Infobox criminal
| criminal_charges = Access child pornography
| convictions      = Guilty
| penalty          = Five months' imprisonment and good behaviour bond
| criminal_status  = Released after four months with remissions
}}
In June 2010 he went on unpaid leave and production of ''Collectors'' was temporarily suspended when he was charged with one count of accessing child pornography. Production of ''Collectors'' resumed in July without Muirhead, and repeats of episodes featuring him were pulled from the ABC's schedule.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.news.com.au/national/abc-is-as-bad-as-the-kgb-says-murhead-lawyer/story-e6frfkvr-1225879216675|title=ABC is as bad as the KGB, says Muirhead lawyer|date=13 June 2010|work=Herald Sun|access-date=16 June 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100616151640/http://www.news.com.au/national/abc-is-as-bad-as-the-kgb-says-murhead-lawyer/story-e6frfkvr-1225879216675| archive-date= 16 June 2010 | url-status= dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.abc.net.au/unleashed/stories/s2927032.htm|title=Abandoning Andy Muirhead: ABC's act of betrayal|last=Barns|first=Greg|date=15 June 2010|work=The Drum Unleashed|publisher=ABC|access-date=17 June 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100618112511/http://www.abc.net.au/unleashed/stories/s2927032.htm| archive-date= 18 June 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref> He was bailed and pleaded not guilty in February 2011.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.news.com.au/entertainment/tv/collectors-host-andy-muirhead-charged-with-a-child-pornography-offence/news-story/473d9db8e65f2cc197182c2dc2000d99 |title=Collectors host Andy Muirhead charged with a child pornography offence |publisher=news.com.au |date=11 June 2010 |access-date=2010-06-16| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100614180548/http://www.news.com.au/entertainment/television/collectors-host-andy-muirhead-charged-with-a-child-pornography-offence/story-e6frfmyi-1225878517950| archive-date= 14 June 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theage.com.au/entertainment/tv-and-radio/abc-host-faces-child-pornography-charge-20100611-y2p2.html |title=ABC Host on Child Porn Charge &#124; Andy Muirhead &#124; Collectors |publisher=The Age |date=11 June 2010 |access-date=2010-06-16 | location=Melbourne | first=Tim | last=Clarke| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100614170429/http://www.theage.com.au/entertainment/tv-and-radio/abc-host-faces-child-pornography-charge-20100611-y2p2.html| archive-date= 14 June 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.smh.com.au/national/former-abc-presenter-andy-muirhead-appears-in-court-20100802-1125x.html|title=Former ABC presenter Andy Muirhead appears in court|first=Andrew|last=Darby|work=The Sydney Morning Herald|access-date=2 December 2010|date=2 August 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/10/13/3036973.htm|title=Muirhead child porn case adjourned|date=13 October 2010|access-date=2 December 2010|publisher=ABC News| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20101108030333/http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2010/10/13/3036973.htm| archive-date= 8 November 2010 | url-status= dead}}</ref> The case was referred<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2011/02/03/3128794.htm?section=justin | archive-url=https://archive.today/20120719211236/http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2011/02/03/3128794.htm?section=justin | url-status=dead | archive-date=19 July 2012 | title=Muirhead denies child porn charges | date=3 February 2011 | access-date=2011-02-03 | publisher=ABC News | location=Hobart }}</ref> back to the Magistrates Court for 1 August 2011. The hearing on that day lasted only an hour rather than the expected two days and was adjourned again.<ref>{{cite news |last=Darby |first=Andrew |title=Thousands of porn files deleted, Muirhead case hears |date=1 August 2011 |work=[[The Age]] |url=https://www.theage.com.au/national/thousands-of-porn-files-deleted-muirhead-case-hears-20110801-1i7e6.html}}</ref> Appearing in court again on 13 March 2012 he pleaded not guilty and the case was adjourned to 14 May 2012,<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.smh.com.au/national/andy-muirhead-pleads-not-guilty-to-child-porn-charges-20120313-1uxew.html | title=Andy Muirhead pleads not guilty to child porn charges|date=13 March 2012|access-date=23 March 2012|work=The Sydney Morning Herald}}</ref> then again to June 2012.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.abc.net.au/news/2012-05-14/muirhead-returns-to-court-in-june/4010088?section=tas | title=Muirhead returns to court in June|date=14 May 2012|access-date=16 May 2012|publisher=ABC News}}</ref>

On 31 July 2012, represented by [[barrister]] [[Kim Baumeler]], Muirhead pleaded guilty.<ref name=pled-guilty>{{cite news | title=Andy Muirhead in custody on child pornography charges | url=http://www.abc.net.au/pm/content/2012/s3557695.htm | date=31 July 2012|last=Ogilvie|first=Felicity| work =PM (ABC Radio)| publisher =Australian Broadcasting Corporation| access-date=1 October 2012| format=transcript}}</ref> He was remanded in custody by [[Ewan Crawford]], Tasmanian Chief Justice. On 14 August 2012 the sentencing was adjourned until 7 September 2012, with Muirhead again remanded in custody. On 1 October he was sentenced to 19 months in prison.<ref name=jailed>{{cite news|url=http://www.abc.net.au/news/2012-10-01/muirhead-jailed-on-child-pornography-charges/4289572 | title= Muirhead jailed for child pornography offences| publisher=ABC News| access-date=1 October 2012| date=1 October 2012| last=Vernon| first=Jackson }}</ref> His sentence was subsequently reduced to five months and security of $5,000 for a three-year period of good behaviour. He was released after four months of the sentence following routine therapy and community service.<ref name="The Age"/>

== Post conviction ==
A scandal involving the use of video material featuring Muirhead in [[New South Wales]] public schools occurred in 2019.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-03-03 |title=Video of disgraced TV presenter convicted of child porn used in distance education |language=en-AU |work=ABC News |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-03-04/video-of-child-porn-offender-used-in-distance-education/10862442 |access-date=2023-02-19}}</ref> A video featuring Muirhead presenting ''Collectors'' had been used as a teaching resource for an unknown number of [[Distance education in Australia|distance education]] students across New South Wales and formed part of the material in the Year 10 History course that was sent out to distance education students studying through [[Camden Haven High School]] on the [[Mid North Coast|NSW mid-north coast]]. A spokesperson for the [[Department of Education (New South Wales)|NSW Department of Education]] said the [[DVD]] of the episode had been withdrawn and other distance education centres that used the course material were made aware so that they no longer used it. The matter became public knowledge after a parent had reported the matter to the school and had spoken to the [[Australian Broadcasting Corporation|ABC]]; the parent reported that a teacher had told him the DVD had been used "for years".
